project.title: Fleet Maintenance and Workshop Safety Standardization
project.objective: Standardize daily vehicle maintenance and workshop safety routines to reduce breakdowns and incidents across the recycling fleet.
deliverables: Standard daily and weekly vehicle inspection checklist
Unified procedure for handling hazardous substances in the workshop
Visual maintenance schedule for all fleet vehicles
Incident and near-miss reporting log for workshop and yard
Training brief for new staff on maintenance and safety routines
constraints: All routines must comply with internal health, safety and hygiene rules
No additional headcount; use existing shifts and staff
Minimal vehicle downtime during peak collection hours
Procedures must be easy to follow for all shifts
All changes must be documented and auditable

risks.risk: New routines slow down vehicle turnaround times
risks.mitigation: Pilot on a subset of vehicles and trim non-essential steps before full rollout.

risks.risk: Staff do not consistently follow new checklists
risks.mitigation: Post visual aids in the workshop and run short refreshers at shift start.

risks.risk: Incomplete incident reporting hides recurring issues
risks.mitigation: Simplify the log format and review entries weekly with the team.
Create clear storage and labelling rules and spot-check compliance weekly.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing breakdowns and ensuring vehicles are safe before leaving the yard.
Team regularly uses chemicals and oils; mishandling can cause incidents.
A tidy, well-marked workspace reduces accidents and speeds up maintenance.
Structured reporting helps identify patterns and fix root causes early.
Clear notes between shifts avoid missed defects and duplicated work.

backlog.task: Draft standard daily vehicle inspection checklist for the fleet
definition_of_done: Checklist covers exterior, interior, fluids, tyres and safety equipment
Reviewed by at least two attendants from different shifts
Approved by fleet supervisor

backlog.task: Define weekly deep-check routine for high-usage vehicles
definition_of_done: List of weekly checks created for high-usage vehicles
Estimated time per vehicle documented
Routine validated on at least two vehicles

backlog.task: Create simple hazardous substances handling and storage guide
definition_of_done: Guide lists all common chemicals and oils used in the workshop
Includes PPE, storage and spill response steps
Health and safety officer signs off the guide

backlog.task: Set up visual fleet maintenance schedule board in the workshop
definition_of_done: Board lists all active vehicles with next service date
Colour coding for overdue, due soon and OK defined
Team uses the board for one week without gaps

backlog.task: Design incident and near-miss reporting log for workshop and yard
definition_of_done: Log template created with date, vehicle, location and description fields
Tested with at least three sample incidents
Storage location and access rules agreed

backlog.task: Standardise shift handover notes format for maintenance team
definition_of_done: Handover template created with open issues and priorities
Trialled across two consecutive shifts
Feedback collected and template adjusted once

backlog.task: Map current maintenance steps and identify redundant actions
definition_of_done: List of current steps documented for daily checks
At least three redundant or duplicate steps identified
Proposal for streamlined flow written

backlog.task: Prepare quick training brief for new staff on maintenance routines
definition_of_done: Brief covers checklists, schedule board and incident log
Language kept simple and under two pages
Reviewed by operations manager or delegate

backlog.task: Define cleaning and tool storage standards for the workshop
definition_of_done: Zones for tools, waste and chemicals defined and labelled
End-of-shift cleaning steps listed
Standards posted visibly in the workshop

backlog.task: Pilot new routines on a small subset of vehicles
definition_of_done: At least five vehicles follow new routines for one week
Issues and delays recorded in a short summary
Decision made on adjustments before full rollout

backlog.task: Agree process for flagging vehicles that must not leave the yard
definition_of_done: Clear criteria for "do not use" status defined
Tagging method for vehicles agreed with fleet supervisor
Process tested on at least one real case

backlog.task: Set up weekly review of logs and schedule with the team
definition_of_done: Recurring weekly slot agreed across shifts
First review held and notes captured
At least two improvement actions logged

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope and pick which vehicles join the initial pilot
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the standardisation project and asking for pilot suggestions

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which vehicle types and how many units will be included in the pilot.
Agree on the pilot duration and start date.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and finalise the daily inspection checklist and weekly routine
threads_plan.trigger: One attendant posts first draft of the daily checklist for feedback

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and items of the daily inspection checklist.
Confirm which checks belong to the weekly deep-check routine instead of daily.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on hazardous substances handling rules and workshop standards
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing initial ideas for chemical handling and workshop organisation

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the hazardous substances handling and storage rules.
Agree on end-of-shift cleaning and tool storage standards.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define how incidents, near-misses and "do not use" vehicles are flagged
threads_plan.trigger: Attendant posts a recent minor incident and asks how it should be logged

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the fields and process for using the incident and near-miss log.
Agree on the visual method to mark vehicles that must not leave the yard.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan training, shift handovers and weekly review cadence
threads_plan.trigger: Message proposing how to onboard new staff and run weekly reviews

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the shift handover template and when it must be filled.
Set the weekly review slot and who must attend the review.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in at shift start to flag critical vehicles and parts issues
End-of-shift note in the channel summarising open maintenance items and handover points
Weekly review thread to look at the schedule board and incident log and agree actions
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture what to keep, change or drop from new routines
